narrative.overview: ModelPick looks like the products it recommends: a chat-app shell with a slim sidebar, one centred question, a rounded composer and an answer in place, in neutral greys with one quiet teal accent.
keyCharacteristics: Chat-app shell: 260px sidebar, centred 720px column, composer docked once an answer exists
The answer reads as an AI answer, not a card
Near-black primary action; teal only for focus, selection and data
Geist throughout; Geist Mono only for table figures
Follows the system theme; a toggle overrides

rules.name: One accent, real jobs
rules.body: Teal marks focus, selection and data. A new colour needs a job no existing token does.

rules.name: One screen
rules.body: Secondary material lives behind the sidebar, never in a scroll.

rules.name: State-only motion
rules.body: 150-200ms, conveys state, off under reduced motion.

dos: Keep the product on one screen
Write the answer as an answer
Keep teal for focus, selection and data
donts: No themes, metaphors, illustrations, 3D or decorative motion
No explainer sections on the page
